entity_geography.text: ocx > ===== FILE: files/1337_9461617_unpacked/1_PLI145F Stenography and Transcription Services - Pre-Market Consultation.docx ===== Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) Provision of Stenography and Transcription Services for Public Sector Bodies 9th November 2026 Introduction As per the Prior Information Notice (PIN) published in October 2026, the Office of Government Procurement (OGP) intends to run a competitive procurement process for the provision of Stenography and Transcription Services in 2026/2027. As part of the procurement process, the OGP is issuing this Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) document and invites responses from Economic Operators in the stenography and transcription services market. This is a market sounding exercise to obtain market information on the provision of stenography and transcription services to assist in the development and structuring of the upcoming Request for Tenders. This is also an opportunity for market players to provide valuable information to the OGP in respect of any issues or challenges relevant to this market and to submit any suggestions which would enhance the provision of stenography and transcription services for Public Sector Bodies (PSBs) in Ireland. It is not a call for competition. Details of the procurement process pursuant to this

To ascertain the specific measures undertaken by the market to align with Ireland’s Climate Action Plan 2025 to become carbon neutral by no later than 2050 (Climate Action Plan 2025). Background to the Procurement Requirements The OGP is considering the establishment of the most appropriate, responsive, and effective procurement solution for the provision of professional stenography and transcription services to Public Service Bodies. The framework will support the accurate, secure, and timely capture of spoken communications across a wide range of official settings, with services provided by Economic Operators using their skills, experience, expertise, and professionalism to deliver value-added solutions. Services may include stenographic and court reporting, transcription, captioning, inquiry reporting, remote and hybrid hearing support, and secure transcript management for interviews, hearings, inquiries, tribunals, public consultations, committee meetings, disciplinary proceedings, investigations, conferences, workshops, stakeholder engagements, and other official proceedings. Transcription services involve the conversion of recorded audio and video content into written records. These services may be provided using traditional human transcription methods, AI-assisted transcription technologies, or a combination of both. Transcripts may be produced in verbatim, edited verbatim, or intelligent transcription formats, depending on the purpose and requirements of the assignment. All transcripts must be subject to appropriate quality assurance measures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements. Uphold the highest standards of transparency, fairness and competitiveness, in line with EU Legislation and national procurement regulations to ensure optimal compliance. Maximise value for money by presenting an aggregated volume of business for up to a maximum period of four (4) years. Streamline the administrative procedures and cost associated with procurement for both public organisations and market participants, making the process as efficient as possible. Amplify the application of existing and forthcoming sustainable procurement policies in alignment with green procurement practices, embedding the integration of green criteria into all procurements funded by public funds. Incorporate Pro Bono services, support labour mobility, promote social inclusion, etc. The key objectives of this market sounding exercise are as follows: To assess the nature, organisational structure and capability of the market to provide Stenography and Transcription Services to the Public Sector Bodies in Ireland.
